name: SkillTechIQ Payment Gateway
author: skilltechiq

sections.description:
The SkillTechIQ Payment Gateway plugin provides a seamless integration between your WooCommerce store and the SkillTechIQ payment processing API.

It allows you to securely accept and process payments directly on your store, providing a smooth checkout experience for your customers.

Features:
* Seamless integration with WooCommerce checkout.
* Secure payment processing via SkillTechIQ API.
* Easy configuration and setup.

External services

This plugin relies on the SkillTechIQ payment processing service to securely handle customer transactions during checkout.

When a customer pays, their order details (including amount, currency, name, email, and phone) are sent to the SkillTechIQ API securely to initiate and verify the payment.
This service is provided by “Skill Tech IQ”.
* Terms of Service: https://skilltechiq.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://skilltechiq.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Find SkillTechIQ Payment Gateway and click “Manage” or “Enable”.
  5. Enter your SkillTechIQ API keys and configure the settings.
  6. Save changes.
sections.faq:
Do I need an SSL certificate?

Yes, since you are processing payments, you must have an SSL certificate installed on your site to ensure transactions are secure.

Where do I find my API keys?

You can find your API keys in your SkillTechIQ merchant dashboard.
